text_block_list.name: Famous UmaTuber
text_block_list.text:
“—And so, answering our viewers' requests today!
We have... none other than...
y-y-yes, this very guest on our show!”

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
I'm Buena Vista!
Looking forward to the stream today!

text_block_list.name: Famous UmaTuber
text_block_list.text:
This channel showcases high-impression trending topics and people, but...
today we've hit our highest concurrent viewership ever!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Wah, so many comments...!
"Been waiting for you, Buena-chan!" "She's my new fave!"
"Watching your races on repeat!" ...Fufu.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Whoa... "I'm coming to cheer for you
at the Victoria Mile!"
I'm so happy...! Please do!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Everyone's support is my source of strength.
Please let me hear your voices as loud as you can!

text_block_list.name: Woman A
text_block_list.text:
—OMG, Buena-chan replied to me!
I'm so happy~, and she's so cute~~!!

text_block_list.name: Man B
text_block_list.text:
Buena-chan's crazy strong, right?
You're definitely gonna win your race too!
Let's go, Victoria Mile!

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text: Buena-chaan!

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text: Do your beeeeeest!!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Yes!
Thank you very much!
The day of the Victoria Mile... The cheers surrounding Buena Vista were even louder than during her Classic year.

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text:
"'Congrats on renewing your record for most consecutive #1s in "The 1st"!'
'I rooted for you so hard!!'"
choice_data_list: (She's pretty much an idol at this point...)
(She's practically an idol at this point...)

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text: You have to win, okay~~!!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"Thank you all so very much
for your support during the Triple Tiara!"

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Even in the Senior Class, so I can show off the brilliance of the Tiara... I'll run with everything I've got!
(Waaaaaaah...!)

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text:
"You hang in there too, Trainer!"
"Be there for Buena-chan!"

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah, that's right! That's our Trainer!"
"We're cheering for all of you today!"
"Come on, appear on media more often!"

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: You were super popular, huh?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"I had a little hunch, you know?
Because you're wonderful, Trainer."

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
If you appear in the media,
it's only natural that you'd become popular, right?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Alright! Now that I've gotten plenty of energy... time to switch into race mode!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
I'm getting all fired up!
After all... Desire-chan is here with me.
choice_data_list: Yeah. So it's been since the Shuka Sho, huh...
Yeah. It's been since the Shuka Sho, hasn't it...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"With how we are now,
we can run an even more amazing race than back then...
and live up to everyone's expectations."

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
The scenery that lies beyond consistently meeting expectations...
That—will become a breathtaking view meant solely for us.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"Buena-san.
It has been quite a while... since we last met here."

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Yeah!
I'm so glad, Desire-chan.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Because you were such an amazing girl,
I came to discover a truly beautiful view at the Shuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
So……
I thought I'd be able to see even further ahead!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"If I run with you...
I can see an even more breathtaking view
that will make everyone happy!"

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: ...Turning the expectations of those around you into strength, that is how you ran all the way here.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
You, who aim for the breathtaking view with everyone, and I, who seek my own solitary world...
I thought we were like mirror images of each other.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Yes, destiny remains unchanged.
The one I must surpass has always been—you.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"The feelings for the world I seek remain in my heart.
And what I must aim for is, as always, just one thing..."

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"Today, of all days...
I shall demonstrate proof of the Saint to my world!"

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
...Thank you for watching over me.
Because it's with you—

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
I can create the breathtaking view of anticipation
that everyone is waiting for!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Hit me with everything you've got, Desire-chan!
I'll take it all!
